props.gloss_en: Rabba: two cubits unwitting, two intentional, two unwitting -- exempt
Rabban Gamliel: there is no awareness for half a measure
Rabba: Rabban Gamliel said it only there, where the measure is completed unwitting; but here, where it is completed intentionally, no
in what case? if throwing -- it is unwitting [throughout]! rather, in carrying
Rava: two cubits unwitting, two intentional, two unwitting -- liable
the Rabbis: there is awareness for half a measure
Rava: the Rabbis said it only there, where it is in his hand; but here, where it is not in his hand, no
in what case? if carrying -- it is in his hand! rather, in throwing
Rabba: one who threw and it came to rest in a dog's mouth or in the mouth of a furnace -- liable
the mishna: if another caught it, or a dog caught it, or it was burnt -- exempt
there [the mishna] he did not intend [the dog's mouth]; here he intends
the mishna: one may eat one eating and be liable for four sin-offerings and one guilt-offering -- an impure man who ate forbidden fat that was notar of consecrated offerings, on Yom Kippur
R' Meir: also, if it was Shabbat and he carried it out in his mouth -- liable
the Sages said to him: that [liability] is not of the same name [as the eating]
Rav Beivai: why [liable]? that is not the way of carrying out! rather, since he intends, his thought makes [his mouth] a place
Rav Beivai: here too, since he intends, his thought makes [the dog's mouth] a place

supports.gloss_en: אף אנן נמי תנינא: R' Meir obligates one who carried food out in his mouth, though that is not the way of carrying (ואמאי? הא אין דרך הוצאה בכך) -- so his intent makes it a place
הכא נמי, כיון דקא מיכוין -- מחשבתו משויא ליה מקום: as the mouth, so the dog's mouth
